name: Dehydroepiandrosterone

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: An adrenal steroid that serves as a precursor to testosterone and estradiol. Sold in the United States as a dietary supplement; a vaginal insert form (prasterone, Intrarosa) is separately FDA-approved. Prohibited in sport.

systems.note: Converted peripherally to testosterone and estradiol; taken for that androgenic effect.
Oral supplement with first-pass hepatic exposure and limited product-quality control.
Downstream androgen conversion reaches prostatic tissue.

monitors.why: The stable circulating form and the direct index of intake.
